reviews.specification:
Implement a personally learned, ground-supported, non-load-bearing wrap-and-inspect trial with optional bounded separation and recovery. No tools, adhesive, cutting, shelter, manufactured rope or stock are granted. Record code dependencies on foundation-open@1 open.probe observation/evidence handling and foundation-forest@1 forest.gather and forest.pickup transfer validation; reuse persistent-work, exact escrow and fractional-material recovery machinery where available, explicitly recording the source implementation and revision. New work is the two-piece arrangement, wrapping state, bounded separation operation and conserved recovery.
References and prerequisites: begin(vineStackId, branchStackIdA, branchStackIdB, x, y, geometry) resolves exact owned items and distinct physical branch pieces; two units may come from one stack only if they resolve to two separate pieces. Reserve exactly 0.2 vine unit and two branch units, each one actual piece. For Lin the nominated vine reference is item-66-lin-388, subject to live ownership, quantity and reach checks. start-0-branches is only an observed potential gather source: use the existing gather contract, with real travel, current accessible stock and 2 energy per branch unit; obtaining two units costs 4 energy and the actual gather action duration. Do not remotely inspect its remaining stock or reserve source material through this interface. All working material and the actor must be within ordinary handling reach; the trial footprint is a clear radius-0.2 ground patch within 0.65 of the actor. Public availability does not confer personal study or handling permission.
Geometry: nominate actual branch centerlines, contact region, orientations, vine segment endpoints and intended wrap path. Lay the pieces beside one another, parallel, with a 0.05-world-distance overlap; attempt one turn around that overlap with a tucked free end, without claiming a self-locking knot. Exact source-bound geometry must fit entirely inside the footprint and support this path using the reserved vine. Resource quantity alone is not length, diameter, flexibility or tensile strength. Do not invent these attributes or split a physically continuous segment merely by decrementing inventory. Resolve represented geometry during the paid examination; if segmentation, dimensions or bend compatibility are unavailable, record the limitation and stop at the feasible geometry-assessment precursor, returning unused reservations. The handoff must implement the missing representation or physical mechanism before offering a wrap or force result, rather than asking repeated model reviews or permanently rejecting the request. No automatic cutting is included.
Costs and progress: disclose this contract before execution. Learning is two individual study rounds at 0.2 energy each. Begin validates references and range without charge, then examines the materials and proposed path for one round at 0.5 energy. A completed examination may legitimately report infeasibility or missing measurable attributes. If feasible, explicitly continue for two work rounds at 1 energy each: first position the real pieces and vine along the intended path; second attempt the wrap and tuck. Each completed step commits its actual positions and material state. Full assessment plus wrap costs three rounds and 2.5 energy, excluding study, gathering and travel. No material is deliberately destroyed by default: 0.2 vine and two branches move from available inventory into uniquely identified trial components. The remainder of Lin's vine stays separate and available. Damage, fragments and losses must be recorded from actual interactions, with source provenance and conserved quantities, never as an unexplained disappearance.
Inspection and test: inspect(trialId) costs one round and 0.2 energy and records visible contact, wrap completion, free ends, measured gaps and displacement without inferring strength. separate(trialId) is a distinct optional one-round action costing 0.5 energy. It supports the pieces on the ground and attempts relative axial separation, stopping at the first of 0.01 world-distance relative movement, tensile load 0.1 in the same explicitly documented simulation load scale as probe, or loss of contact/slip/breakage. This is not a suspended-weight test and the load scale must not be presented as newtons without a real conversion. Record requested and actually attained displacement, load, direction, elapsed work, slippage, breakage and stop reason. Implement a deterministic bounded contact/tension mechanism using actual source-bound geometry and mechanical parameters; reuse a compatible existing physical handler if available and record its provenance. Do not infer joining strength from resource name or flexibility alone. If required mechanical parameters or a force mechanism are absent, disable force application, perform only the disclosed paid visual inspection if chosen, and report separation response unassessed. Do not substitute an arbitrary held=true/false result. The geometry-only trial is the smallest releasable precursor; the same handoff must retain the missing separation mechanism for development. Repeated tests pay again and operate on the altered surviving arrangement, never a reset specimen.
Conservation, recovery and lifecycle: use exact processId for resume/cancel and exact trialId for inspect/test/recover. Record quantities, component identities, provenance, stage, paid rounds, positions, escrow and damage after each atomic step. Only remaining work is charged on resume, after revalidating reach, access and the live geometry; no automatic reconstruction of disturbed work. Other actions interrupt without erasing paid work. Global development/review pauses advance no rounds. Cancel ends the work lock and returns unplaced surviving escrow once; placed material stays physically where it is. recover(trialId) costs one round and 0.5 energy to unwrap and retrieve the reachable, releasable surviving portions, including fractional vine; recover only portions actually freed by that round. If blocked or incomplete, record remaining material and allow another explicitly paid attempt. Recovery removes exactly those portions from the trial. Returned material retains damage and source identity; fragments remain real nonduplicated material, not intact replacement vine. Death releases locks and leaves placed components plus unplaced escrow at their actual location under ordinary world ownership/death rules, without remote recovery. No spent energy, time, damaged material or performed work is refunded. Invalid references fail before charge; a performed informative examination retains its disclosed cost. Cancellation does not secretly perform recovery.
The product is a persistent recoverable physical trial, possibly a loose or failed wrap, plus dated personal observations—not a certified joint, tool or shelter. No unattended labor, self-tightening, healing or automatic upkeep occurs. Existing environmental ageing continues during ordinary world time. There is no invented maintenance benefit or fee: inspect before later testing, and require separately paid, conserved physical work for any retie or repair not included here. No automatic communication or assistance: any other participant must independently communicate, learn where required and perform their own authorized actions. Do not change protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Establish all validations, progress, physical bounds and lifecycle rules in executable code before exposing execution.
